settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language and backup options for this device.
settings.resetFooter: Permanently deletes every reptile and activity record stored on this device. Your language setting will not change.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.exportFooter: Backups are standard ZIP files containing your selected data, WebP photos and any attached documents.
backup.restoreFooter: Restoring a backup replaces its included data. A reptiles-and-records backup replaces your current reptiles and records; a preferences-only backup keeps them.

backup.restoreMessage_other: This backup has {{animals}} reptiles and {{records}} records. It will replace your current reptiles and records.
backup.restoreError: Could not restore this backup. Please try again.
